theorem: For a normalized regular finite incidence U and an orthogonal source partition, C=P_in U and Q=P_out U satisfy I-C*C=Q*Q exactly.
interpretation: Q is the omitted relative incidence map, so the first-order factorization precedes and explains the positive defect rather than square-rooting it afterward.
C2_hostile_test: Selecting one of the two points in every C2 difference fiber gives C*C=Q*Q=(1/2)I; every fixed unweighted split gives a constant rational defect.
remaining_obstructions: Bare deck combinatorics has no analytic height dependence.
The complementary incidence is generally rectangular and has no signed determinant without an oriented determinant-line complex.
No physical relative-chain pushforward is supplied.
open_target: Construct analytic archimedean weights or a moving relative boundary preserving the Parseval identity and cutoff compatibility.
status: first non-tautological algebraic Q construction; insufficient for Xi
